svg.aria-label: Vector clocks: D1 [Sx:1] is updated through Sx to D2 [Sx:2]. Two clients then update D2 at the same time, through Sy (D3 [Sx:2, Sy:1]) and through Sz (D4 [Sx:2, Sz:1]). Neither clock dominates the other, so they conflict; a client reconciles them and writes D5 [Sx:3, Sy:1, Sz:1] through Sx.
svg.title: Vector clocks
